entries.label: balancing_set
entries.why: Explained in direction; level unexplained (BS-10). T_CIT <- E_NFPR T4a total, 6,55,713 -> 6,38,728 (-16,985, -2.6%; z 0.974; free low; binding: t4.total (target 9,11,055, balanced 9,11,054, at its lower edge)). T4a splits corporation tax (MH 0020, held by t4.total) by the old-base 2022-23 D5 shares; no CPSE tax series exists in clean data (taxes-27). E_NFPU's prior surplus (3,12,829, government-33) raised the public NFC share until the Wave C band t4a.nfpu (target 75,259, balanced 94,074, at its upper edge) (+-25% of the old-base share, as t4a.fc) stopped it, and E_NFPR (the residual of the fixed total) paid correspondingly less; the earlier run had +64%. GRAS (no weights, no constraints) gives 6,36,078. The prior account gaps (BALANCING.md 'Pre-balancing imbalances'; closure institution_gaps): G_STA 4,50,426, households Z -3,84,547, E_NFPU 3,12,829, G_CEN -2,98,948, E_NBFC 2,32,893, E_INSP -1,21,568, E_NFPR -1,13,892, E_BANK -1,02,838, E_RBI 25,646.

entries.label: balancing_set
entries.why: Explained. T_PIT <- E_NFPR T3 quasi_corporate, 2,15,261 -> 2,32,466 (17,205, +8.0%; z 1.080; free low; binding: t3.total (target 10,52,638, balanced 10,52,637, at its lower edge)). This is the household saving gap Z. t3.total holds taxes on income other than CIT at the Receipt Budget and RBI State Finances cash (binding); when Z (-3,84,547) pushed households' T3a down (t3.households allows 10% around the old-base household share), the only other T3 payers, the quasi-corporations in E_NFPR and E_BANK (D2-11), took the rest. GRAS (no weights, no constraints) gives 2,35,983.

entries.label: balancing_set
entries.why: Explained in direction; level unexplained (BS-9). T_SGST <- C_CNST P7a total, 1,60,203 -> 1,55,142 (-5,060, -3.2%; z 0.968; free medium; binding: product_taxes.c_cnst (target 3,24,456, balanced 3,24,457, at its upper edge); p7a.total (target 30,15,341, balanced 30,15,340, at its lower edge)). The SGST on construction is the RAS placement of the States' cash SGST in the SUT product-tax column of C_CNST (held by production's SUT total and p7a.total); balancing moved the column toward the Union's taxes because of the prior's Centre shortfall (-2,98,948) and States' excess (4,50,426), not tax evidence; no clean source splits GST on construction between CGST and SGST cash. GRAS (no weights, no constraints) gives 1,60,203. The prior account gaps (BALANCING.md 'Pre-balancing imbalances'; closure institution_gaps): G_STA 4,50,426, households Z -3,84,547, E_NFPU 3,12,829, G_CEN -2,98,948, E_NBFC 2,32,893, E_INSP -1,21,568, E_NFPR -1,13,892, E_BANK -1,02,838, E_RBI 25,646.

entries.label: balancing_set
entries.why: Explained. T_SVAT <- C_RPET P7a non_pol_vat, 1,17,019 -> 1,09,611 (-7,408, -6.3%; z 0.937; free low; binding: product_taxes.c_rpet (target 7,00,419, balanced 7,00,417, at its lower edge); p7a.total (target 30,15,341, balanced 30,15,340, at its lower edge)). The product-tax cells of a commodity are held by production's SUT product-tax total and p7a.total binds; inside it, the prior's placement is weak where plan fallback (b) put non-petroleum State VAT on petroleum products and the RAS squeezed PPAC's Union excise on POL (2,73,684) to 0.977 of it (taxes-3, V-TX-3). Balancing re-split C_RPET's fixed SUT product taxes from the fallback State VAT toward Union excise, i.e. toward the PPAC figure and away from the placement taxes-3 flags; the Centre/State gap of the prior (G_CEN -2,98,948, G_STA 4,50,426) is what pushed it. GRAS (no weights, no constraints) gives 1,17,019.
